purpose: Create and download asynchronous vehicle-data exports, account ZIP archives, and authenticated recurring export schedules.
primaryGoal: Choose export data, format, columns, vehicle and business date bounds; queue an export, monitor its history and download its artifact.

dataSources.behavior: Historical useDataState; unconditionally polls every 10000ms; list-derived summaries explicitly describe loaded history, not global or unique session totals. POST invalidates export-jobs; download opens a browser tab.
useDataState retains vehicle data; fatal failure has retry above wizard; local export selectors initialize and synchronize from useSelectedVehicle.
Five-minute staleTime; signal forwarded; picker currently restricts catalog lookup to drives and charging; required columns locked, selections retain catalog order, null selection omits columns.
Mutation toast and broadcast invalidation; optional vehicle/date bounds; account ZIP cap warning and global JobProgressDrawer are preserved capabilities.
Authenticated ownership documented by router; RequiresAuth capability=session_list gates mounted panel; list safeArray, signal forwarding, 60000ms polling; mutation toasts and broadcast invalidation.
dataSources.limits: Source route matching only; authentication, delivery dispatch, worker execution and ZIP contents were not exercised.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Wizard and account panel duplicate local vehicle state, global synchronization and selection parsing at 497-530 and 1034-1059. Local selectors are legitimate here because /data-export disables the shell vehicle picker.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Use a feature-local adapter for shared vehicle-selection behavior while preserving distinct all-values and independent export forms. Do not delete selectors or add a workspace control.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Local ExportJobSummary, query and create mutation compete with useExports.ts:35-66,96-129; local GETs bypass existing safeArray, cancellation and mutation broadcast behavior.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Consolidate through existing export/vehicle hooks only after preserving the current 10-second polling contract and resolving type support. Do not silently adopt a different polling default.

responsive.sourceStrategy: Wizard type cards reflow at sm/lg/2xl; main grid stacks until xl; format/preset controls wrap; account fields stack until sm; schedules use explicit overflow-x-auto.

issues.detail: History passes mobileColumns=['type','status','time'], omitting actions, format, vehicle, records, size and duration. DataTable.tsx:724-725 applies hidden md:table-cell; the caller supplies neither mobilePresentation nor expanded-row detail. Download and failed-job explanation are in the hidden actions column.
issues.fix: Use the existing DataTable mobilePresentation contract with all metadata and ready-job download/failed-job details retained, or retain accessible horizontal-scroll columns. Keep tableId and the table pipeline.

issues.detail: Schedule title and New schedule button share a non-wrapping flex row with p-6 at all widths; export-history title, active badge and refresh similarly share a non-wrapping header at DataExportPage.tsx:973. Narrow/translated label fit is a source risk, not a measured overflow.
issues.fix: Permit wrapping/stacking using existing layout utilities and verify 320px plus long labels without hiding controls.

positiveEvidence: Type RadioCards use a named radiogroup and decorative aria-hidden icons at DataExportPage.tsx:191-215; RadioCard.tsx:54-68 uses native radios.
Format/preset buttons expose aria-pressed; custom dates and account fields supply primitive labels.
Scheduled table headers have scope=col and delete uses ConfirmDialog.
accessibility.runtime: Keyboard, focus, screen reader, effective contrast, forced colors and touch-target acceptance unverified.

issues.detail: Wizard Select has no label, id/label association, aria-label or aria-labelledby. Its preceding category-barrel Label is a typography span, not the Select's own associated label; Select.tsx:67-78 only renders its associated label when label is supplied.
issues.fix: Pass the localized vehicle label directly to Select or give explicit stable id/aria-labelledby wiring. Preserve the visible step heading and all-vehicles choice.

issues.detail: Failure text is truncated to 120px and full text is only in title; no focusable detail action is supplied. Mobile also hides the entire actions cell.
issues.fix: Expose the complete failure explanation in reachable text or an existing accessible disclosure/detail surface.

states.loading: Jobs initial-load skeletons; summary loading flags; column-catalog skeleton; schedules skeletons. Vehicles have no dedicated loading placeholder in wizard and selector is absent until data arrives.
states.empty: History empty state directs creation above; schedules empty state paired with New schedule button; unknown summary source stays unavailable.
states.error: Fatal jobs alert and history QueryError; vehicle fatal QueryError/retry; mutation toasts; failed job explanation; schedule fatal QueryError.
states.staleOffline: useDataState and StaleRefreshWarning retain jobs, vehicles and schedules on refresh failures; summaries receive retained flag. Actual offline UI unverified.

issues.detail: Column-catalog error, missing response, unsupported selection and empty catalog all return null. Refresh failure hides a previously useful catalog; initial failure provides no explanation or retry.
issues.fix: Use current data-state and feedback components to retain catalog data on refresh failure and offer retry on fatal failure. Keep truly unsupported types distinct and allow default-all export behavior.

issues.detail: File-size render/filter uses zeroAsEmpty=true at 925 and 919, collapsing measured zero bytes into the same dash used for missing size.
issues.fix: Render known zero bytes distinctly while retaining missing/invalid values as unknown; keep raw file_size and source formatter preferences.

visualIssues.detail: Static CSV/JSON explanation cards opt into hover cyan/purple border tint. GlassPanel.tsx:31-35,70-75 confirms these are hover-border tints, not an actual glow; no claim of rendered bloom. Multiple decorative format hues are unnecessary.
visualIssues.fix: Keep both preview cards and content; prefer neutral panel interaction treatment and restrained accent for selected/actionable controls only.

visualIssues.detail: Account warning separator uses border-white/[0.06] rather than the established semantic border variable.
visualIssues.fix: Use the existing border-subtle token; verify composed contrast in light/dark/custom themes rather than claiming token names prove contrast.

architectureIssues.detail: Formatter returns {value} without required unit. MetricDisplayOptions.formatter at web\src\lib\metric-reference\types.ts:38-41 requires both value:string and unit:string. This is a source-confirmed type-contract error; no compiler was executed and no compiler output is claimed.
architectureIssues.fix: Preserve raw byte metric and formatBytes output; supply the required unit field consistently with the existing combined-string specialist contract. Record a targeted compiler finding, not a source edit in Phase 0.

architectureIssues.detail: Account optional dates are converted to ISO timestamps. Mounted SubmitAccountJob parses only YYYY-MM-DD at internal\api\exports\handler.go:405-419. Thus either supplied date is rejected by the inspected handler.
architectureIssues.fix: Align request dates with the existing endpoint contract and retain both optional bounds; resolve end-bound/timezone semantics with backend owner without inventing them. Do not run a private-data export to verify.

architectureIssues.rule: MDC-045 / preserve capabilities without invented backend support
architectureIssues.detail: Wizard submits full_backup, maintenance and energy directly as type. Mounted SubmitJob's allowlist at internal\api\exports\handler.go:141-150 accepts backup, not full_backup, and excludes maintenance/energy. Analytics also forces JSON at handler.go:156-158 despite wizard offering CSV.
architectureIssues.fix: Resolve wire identifiers and supported formats with integration owner while preserving visible export intentions. Do not delete advertised capabilities as cosmetic cleanup or claim unsupported export implementations exist.

architectureIssues.detail: Both page-local queryFns ignore TanStack Query signal; the existing useExports read hooks forward it.
architectureIssues.fix: Forward signal through request, preferably through the existing domain owner, retaining keys, payloads, trust state and polling interval.

priority.reason: Source-confirmed formatter contract error, account date/type endpoint mismatches and hidden mobile download action precede cosmetic work.
order: Resolve export request contracts without data/feature loss
Restore mobile full details/actions and selector names
Retain column catalog on refresh errors

requiredSharedChanges.name: Export domain contract reconciliation
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Typed supported export identifiers/formats, account date-bound payload contract, existing ExportJobSummary and read cancellation; retain mutation feedback/broadcast and independent capability intents.
dependsOn: Integration decision for full_backup/maintenance/energy and analytics CSV

requiredSharedChanges.name: Reuse existing mobile table presentation; no new shared renderer
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Existing mobilePresentation, complete metadata, accessible row action/detail, same loaded-row filtering/pagination and stable tableId. Preserve failed/ready/unknown status states.

competingImplementations.detail: Local job type/query/create pipeline overlaps existing domain hook/type; keep polling and accepted request semantics deliberate during consolidation.
Summary already reuses OperationalBrief/useOperationalMetrics; do not replace it with a second KPI/stat implementation.

sectionNames: Create a new export: type/format/columns/vehicle/date wizard
actions: Refresh jobs from page header and history
Select/clear catalog columns; required columns locked
Select all/specific vehicle in wizard and account export
Toggle custom range and edit both bounds
dataBehavior: Keep raw SI export previews and native catalog column identities; no display conversion in export payloads.
Retain null untouched/default-all column selection, always-included columns, catalog order and type-switch reset.
Retain jobs polling/cache key, historical trust/retained data, vehicle retry, independent schedule source and authentication boundary.
Summary scope is loaded jobs only; counts may overlap and byte totals include recorded sizes only. Do not relabel as unique database totals.
Preserve unknown/forward-compatible type, format and status badge fallbacks.

Export business dates are local form inputs, not analytical workspace range. /data-export is absent from RANGE_ENABLED_PATHS and explicitly vehicle-disabled at workspaceScope.ts:115; required local selectors must remain.
Positive local vehicle changes currently update shared selected vehicle; choosing all does not clear shared selection. Preserve/resolve intentionally, not by deleting controls.
Keep stable tableId=system:data-export-jobs, download URL construction, user locale/precision, warnings about ZIP caps, and schedule cron/range/delivery/ownership data.
Preview examples are explanatory samples, not real measured data; never route them into production summaries.
preservation.changesMade: No source or shared files changed.
